name: What can be done in a small backyard renovation?

mainEntity.name: What can be done in a small backyard in Los Angeles without making it feel crowded?
mainEntity.text: What can be done in a small backyard in Los Angeles without making it feel crowded?

acceptedAnswer.text: Small backyards often benefit more from smart layout than from adding many features. In compact Los Angeles yards, the strongest designs usually combine a small dining area, a seating corner, vertical or layered planting, and subtle lighting rather than trying to fit every trend. Built-in benches, slim planters, foldable or integrated furniture, and clean hardscape lines can make the yard feel larger. Choosing fewer materials and repeating them across the space also helps. A good small-yard renovation should preserve walking paths, keep sightlines open, and avoid bulky structures that dominate the footprint. Even modest changes can make a small yard feel like a true extension of the home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small backyards can still be transformed with compact patios, built-in seating, vertical planting, slim planters, lighting, and multi-use zones. The best designs prioritize circulation and storage so the space feels open instead of overloaded with separate features.
